title: Desk Training Notes: Assumption of a Farm Real Estate Loan When Mortgaged Land Is Sold
content:
**The rule.** When land mortgaged to a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage is sold, the loan is due on sale unless a buyer who is or becomes a member assumes it. An assumption is registered as an assumption request, is available only on a product whose terms allow assumption, requires credit approval of the buyer and no past-due installment, and keeps the rate, schedule and maturity unchanged. On the effective date the assuming member becomes the borrower and an assumption fee of the product's assumption fee percentage of the principal balance assumed, rounded to cents, is assessed; the selling member is released from the note only by the credit officer's written release. Products whose terms do not allow assumption are paid off on sale.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which products can be assumed?**
Only those whose terms allow assumption; the others are paid off when the land is sold.

**What must be in place for an assumption?**
A buyer who is or becomes a member, an assumption request, the buyer's credit approval, and no past-due installment on the loan.

**What changes and what does not?**
The rate, the schedule and the maturity stay as they are. On the effective date the assuming member becomes the borrower.

**Is the seller off the note?**
Only by the credit officer's written release.

**What fee is charged?**
The product's assumption fee percentage of the principal balance assumed, rounded to cents.

**Fee illustration (hypothetical).** A buyer assumes a FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage with USD 420000.00 of principal: 1.0 percent of 420000.00 is USD 4200.00.

| Product terms allow assumption | Buyer credit-approved | Installment past due | Outcome when the land is sold |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | no | the buyer may assume the loan |
| yes | no | — | no assumption; the loan is due on sale |
| yes | yes | yes | no assumption; the loan is due on sale |
| no | — | — | paid off on sale |
